exposure: Group C: PAE prevented bleeding post-hysterectomy (n=4)
Group B: PAE failed, hysterectomy required (n=4)
Group A: PAE successful in preventing bleeding and avoiding hysterectomy (n=4)
cohort: 12 patients with abnormal placental implantation (API) and intractable intraoperative postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) who underwent PAE after caesarean delivery
finding: PAE is a minimally invasive technique that may help to prevent hysterectomy and control PPH in API pregnancies without complications.
